title: The Silenced Painter
description: A woman wearing an ornate metal muzzle stands in a decaying doorway, her hand pressed against a painting of a faceless red figure. She holds a painter's palette in her other hand while heavy red and blue curtains frame the scene.
prompt: A surreal scene of a woman standing in a decaying ornate doorway with peeling gold paint, wearing an intricate metal muzzle over her mouth. She holds a painter's palette covered in thick paint in one hand and presses her other hand against a canvas showing a faceless red figure. Heavy red and blue velvet curtains hang beside her, a worn green chair with paint tubes sits nearby, black and white checkered floor, dramatic lighting from the canvas, stormy sea visible in the background, heavy symbolic atmosphere, detailed textures
